# Sampling correctness bugs {#sec-sampling-bugs}

- The sampling defects, separated from the sampling features. Grouping
  labels: `bug`, the `mcmc` cluster.
- Every issue here is a fix, which is what makes the milestone a patch
  release: it can ship without waiting on the adaptive sampler, and it
  answers the maintainer's steer that bugs should be solved as early
  as possible.

**Why this is its own milestone.** These ten issues used to sit inside
a single 34-issue sampling milestone alongside SNAPER, NUTS and the
log-prob rework. That guaranteed the whole thing was a minor release
and put a set of long-standing bugs behind a research-scale feature.
Split out, they ship first and they ship as a patch.

**The thinning cluster is one bug, reported four times.**
[#241](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/241),
[#318](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/318),
[#567](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/567) and
[#609](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/609) all describe
`thin`, `pb_update` and `n_samples` interacting badly when they are not
multiples of each other - a TensorFlow error from a combination of
arguments that ought to be legal, or silently accepted and wrong.
Diagnose them together and they are likely one arithmetic fix plus one
validation message; taken one at a time they look like four unrelated
reports.

**The seed pair is a lifecycle problem, not an RNG problem.**
[#285](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/285) and
[#427](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/427) say the same
thing from two directions: a seed set before TensorFlow initialises
does not take, and one set afterwards does.
[#736](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/736) is the
documentation that has to change with the fix, which is why it travels
here rather than with the other documentation issues - a seed
explanation written against the broken behaviour is worse than none.

The remaining three are independent: a numerical-handling failure in
`mcmc()` ([#577](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/577)), `calculate()` hanging rather than erroring on NaN
parameters ([#617](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/617)), and a suspected memory leak ([#279](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/279)).

### [Issue #241](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/241)

- 2018-10-22
- bug
- Thinning with many bad samples raises an error.
- finding: part of the thin/pb_update TensorArray root cause shared with [#318](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/318)/#567/#609.
- fix: fix the shared root cause; add the bad-sample case as a test.
- priority: medium.

### [Issue #279](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/279)

- 2019-05-04
- bug
- A possible memory leak in `mcmc()`.
- finding: likely TF-side graph/retracing growth; relates to [#546](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/546).
- fix: profile long runs against the [#546](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/546) retracing hypothesis (graph re-tracing / growth across iterations); if confirmed, the fix is the stable input signatures from [#546](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/546); otherwise document as upstream.
- priority: medium (diagnose-first).

### [Issue #285](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/285)

- 2019-06-15
- documentation
- greta appears not to respect the random seed.
- finding: seed only takes effect after TF init (see [#427](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/427)); GPU non-determinism is upstream.
- fix: adopt stateless seeds; document GPU caveat.
- priority: medium.

### [Issue #318](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/318)

- 2019-09-26
- (none)
- `thin` + `pb_update` combinations produce TF errors.
- finding: the root cause of the thin trio ([#241](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/241)/#567/#609) - a TensorArray sizing issue.
- fix: fix the shared cause; parametrise tests over thin/pb_update.
- priority: high (root cause).

### [Issue #427](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/427)

- 2021-06-09
- (none)
- A specific seed is only respected after TF has initialised.
- finding: init-order sensitivity, fixed by stateless seeds.
- fix: adopt TFP stateless seeds; deterministic regardless of init order.
- priority: medium.

### [Issue #567](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/567)

- 2022-10-18
- Up Next
- `extra_samples()` fails when thin/pb_update/n_samples aren't multiples.
- finding: thin-trio root cause ([#318](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/318)).
- fix: fix the shared cause; test non-multiple combinations.
- priority: medium.

### [Issue #577](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/577)

- 2022-12-09
- TF2
- A TF2 failure in "numerical issues are handled in mcmc".
- finding: records real-but-unreproduced behaviour; not sweep-closable.
- fix: reproduce under the conformance suite; fix or document.
- priority: medium.

### [Issue #609](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/609)

- 2024-02-08
- Up Next
- Thinning creates a python error at n_samples 1000, thin 100.
- finding: thin-trio root cause ([#318](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/318)).
- fix: resolved by the shared fix; add this exact case as a test.
- priority: medium.

### [Issue #617](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/617)

- 2024-03-03
- Up Next
- `calculate()` hangs with NaN parameters in a sampling distribution.
- finding: a NaN guard missing in the calculate/sampling path; relates to [#244](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/244)'s NaN loop.
- fix: detect NaN parameters; error instead of hang.
- priority: medium.

### [Issue #736](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/736)

- 2024-10-31
- (none)
- Update the documentation for setting the MCMC seed.
- finding: pairs with the stateless-seed work ([#285](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/285)/#427).
- fix: document seeding once stateless seeds land.
- priority: low.
